assumptions: Synthetic example; symbols and prices are fictional and denominated in USD.
Starting portfolio holds 100 shares of XOLD-A at $100 and 200 shares of XOLD-B at $50; no cash.
Sell both holdings and allocate the $20,000 proceeds equally to two new equities; prices remain fixed and fees, taxes and slippage are zero.
traded_value is the gross sum of quantity multiplied by price across buys and sells.
